sn13.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn13.1:1.3: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāya paṃsuṃ āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi
sn13.1:1.5: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yo cāyaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāya paṃsu āropito ayaṃ ca mahāpaṭhavīti.
sn13.1:2.2: appamattako bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāya paṃsu āropito
sn13.1:2.3: neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti mahāpaṭhaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāya paṃsu āropitoti.
sn13.1:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa abhisametāvino etadeva bahutaraṃ dukkhaṃ yadidaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ
sn13.1:2.6: neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upeti purimaṃ dukkhakkhandhaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnaṃ upanidhāya yadidaṃ sattakkhattuparamatā.
